data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for drawing scribbles, text, shapes and images on a canvas.
data.what_it_does: Provides a PainterController and FlutterPainter widget to draw free‑style strokes, add text, shapes, and images, and manipulate them (move, scale, rotate). Supports undo/redo, JSON save/restore and image export.
use_when: You need an interactive drawing surface inside a Flutter app
You want to let users annotate images or create sketches with text and shapes
avoid_when: You require vector‑based export or advanced photo‑editing features
You need a lightweight widget for simple static images
strengths: Rich set of drawable types (free‑style, text, shapes, images)
weaknesses: No vector export or advanced image processing
May add overhead for simple use cases
data.minimal_example: class ExampleWidget extends StatefulWidget {const ExampleWidget({Key? key}): super(key:key);} class _ExampleWidgetState extends State<ExampleWidget> {final PainterController controller = PainterController(); @override Widget build(BuildContext context) {return SizedBox(width:300,height:300,child:FlutterPainter(controller:controller));}}
